lines.zh: : 我还是不明白这些和 Ayane 有什么关系。

lines.en: : I really just want to know what compelled you to break someone else in exchange for your own satisfaction.
lines.zh: : 我真的只是想知道，是什么驱使你为了自己的满足去伤害别人。

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate16
: I want you to think {i}long{/i} and {i}hard{/i} about that last sentence, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我希望你对我最后那句话{i}好好地{/i}、{i}认真地{/i}想一想，老师。

lines.en: : Isn’t that one more thing that the two of us have in common?
lines.zh: : 那不也是我们俩的又一个共同点吗？

lines.en: : Breaking others for our own satisfaction?
lines.zh: : 为了自己的满足去伤害别人？

lines.en: : If you think you’re going to be able to do all of these things without any sort of consequences, you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 如果你以为你能做所有这些事却不付出任何代价，那你就错了。

lines.en: : You can't {i}fix{/i} anything. You can only break things.
lines.zh: : 你什么都{i}修{/i}不好。你只能把东西弄坏。

lines.en: : So what’s the problem if I do the same every once in a while? It gets both of us off, doesn't it?
lines.zh: : 那我偶尔也做同样的事，有什么问题吗？反正我们俩都爽了，不是吗？

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate6
: And hey! Maybe I’ll even be lucky enough to be the one you finish inside of next time.
lines.zh: : 还有，嘿！也许我甚至够幸运，能成为你下次射在里面的人。

lines.en: : That would be swell. It’s not like I’ve already offered myself to you or anything.
lines.zh: : 那可太棒了。又不是我早就主动把自己送上门了之类的。

lines.en: : And it’s not like I literally followed you behind a bathroom just to ask if I could jerk you off on the beach.
lines.zh: : 又不是我真的跟着你走到洗手间后面，就为了问我在海滩上能不能帮你撸。

lines.en: : So just keep fucking other girls. It’s cool. I’ll be good.
lines.zh: : 所以你继续操别的女孩吧。没关系。我会乖乖的。

lines.en: : I’ll wait my turn.
lines.zh: : 我会等我的轮次。

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate16
: Anyway, rant over I guess.
lines.zh: : 总之，牢骚发完了，我猜。

lines.en: : Sorry for the thing with Ayane. Hope she’s not as bummed out as you are about it.
lines.zh: : Ayane 那件事对不起了。希望她没有你这么垂头丧气。

lines.en: : My bad.
lines.zh: : 我的错。

lines.en: : I’m not {i}bummed out{/i}. I just wish you’d think about other people a little more.
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}垂头丧气{/i}。我只是希望你多为别人想想。

lines.en: : I’ll start doing that the second you do.
lines.zh: : 你开始那么做的那一秒，我也会开始。

lines.en: : Until then, let’s just keep having fun. Okay?
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我们就继续开心吧。好吗？

lines.en: Kirin and I stand there staring at each other for what feels like hours.
lines.zh: Kirin 和我站在那儿盯着彼此，感觉像过了好几个小时。

lines.en: But despite how hard I try to siphon some emotion out of those green eyes, I get nothing.
lines.zh: 但不管我多努力想从那双绿眼睛里榨出一点情绪，我什么都得不到。

lines.en: She’s just blank.
lines.zh: 她只是一片空白。

lines.en: Wait.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: She’s not blank.
lines.zh: 她不是空白。

lines.en: She’s pitch black.
lines.zh: 她是一片漆黑。

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate17
: Oh! Thanks for never asking for money for letting Karin and me crash in that inn, by the way.
lines.zh: : 哦！顺便说一句，谢谢你从没因为让 Karin 和我蹭住那家旅馆而收钱。

lines.en: : She wouldn’t shut up about how kind it was for the entire ride home. I almost jumped out of the bus.
lines.zh: : 回家的路上她一直在念叨你有多好心，我差点从巴士上跳下去。

lines.en: : To be fair, I didn’t really pay either. That was all Ayane.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我也没真付钱。那都是 Ayane 出的。

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate18
: Of course it was.
lines.zh: : 当然了。

lines.en: : Fucking bubble-wrap queen of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 的气泡纸女王。

lines.en: : That’s an absolutely horrible nickname.
lines.zh: : 这绰号真是烂透了。

lines.en: : Blame her father’s absolutely horrible invention.
lines.zh: : 怪她老爸那个烂透了的发明吧。

lines.en: : Still cool, though. Being that rich, I mean.
lines.zh: : 不过还是挺酷的。我是说那么有钱。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what my dad does.
lines.zh: : 我连我爸是干什么的都不知道。

lines.en: : Hell, this could be his office building and I wouldn’t even know it.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，就算这栋办公楼是他的，我也不会知道。

lines.en: : Are you not on good terms with your parents or something?
lines.zh: : 你跟父母关系不好还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate6
: Nothing like that. Our terms are fine. I just try not to get too involved, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不是那么回事。我们关系挺好的。我只是尽量不太掺和，我猜。

lines.en: : Which might be why it always seems like I’m trying to get involved elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 这大概就是为什么我看起来总是在别的地方拼命想掺和。

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate4
: Like inside of your pants~
lines.zh: : 比如钻进你的裤子里~

lines.en: : Thank you, Kirin. For reminding me of your strangely high sex drive despite being a literal virgin.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Kirin。谢谢你提醒我，尽管你是个货真价实的处女，性欲却高得离谱。

lines.en: : Literal, yes. But I can assure you my mind is quite corrupt already.
lines.zh: : 身体上是。但我可以向你保证，我的脑子早就相当堕落了。

lines.en: : Oh I’m well aware of that. You talked about porn the first time I came over.
lines.zh: : 哦，这点我清楚得很。我第一次去你家的时候你就聊色情片了。

lines.en: : I’ll talk about it again right now if you want.
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意，我现在就能再聊一次。

lines.en: : Wanna compare browser histories? I think you’ll be surprised by some of my tastes.
lines.zh: : 想比比浏览器历史记录吗？我觉得我的一些口味会让你惊讶。

lines.en: : Honestly, I don’t think anything about you would surprise me at this point.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得到了这个地步，你身上没有任何事能让我惊讶了。

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate12
: Can I take that as you thinking I’m interesting?
lines.zh: : 那我可以把这话理解为你觉得我很有趣吗？

lines.en: : Interesting is an understatement.
lines.zh: : 有趣都说轻了。

lines.en: : I’d be down to write a thesis paper with you as the subject if I actually cared anything about actual work.
lines.zh: : 我要是真对正经工作有哪怕一点在意，我都愿意以你为题写一篇学位论文。

lines.en: : That sounds boring. Let’s just make out instead.
lines.zh: : 那听起来很无聊。我们直接接吻吧。

lines.en: As much as I'm enticed by the offer to stay here and make out with Kirin, I feel like I should probably be leaving right about now...
lines.zh: 虽然留下来和 Kirin 接吻这个提议相当诱人，但我觉得我现在大概该走了……

lines.en: It’s already late and I really don’t want to have to walk home in the pitch black.
lines.zh: 已经很晚了，我真的不想在一片漆黑里走回家。

lines.en: Is that a selfish reason? Sure. But it’s not like Kirin should be out right now either.
lines.zh: 这个理由自私吗？当然。但 Kirin 现在也不该在外面。

lines.en: Her sister and her parents are probably still eating and talking about their day and...other family stuff, I guess.
lines.zh: 她姐姐和她爸妈大概还在吃饭、聊这一天的事，还有……别的家庭话题，我猜。

lines.en: She has no place out here next to me.
lines.zh: 她没有理由在这儿、在我身边。

lines.en: : We can make out next time. I need to start heading back.
lines.zh: : 我们下次再接吻吧。我得开始往回走了。

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate3
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Even though I studied in preparation for you to stick your tongue down my throat?
lines.zh: : 尽管我还为了你把舌头伸进我嘴里而做了预习？

lines.en: : You...studied how to make out?
lines.zh: : 你……预习了怎么接吻？

lines.en: scene kirinnightdate19
: Well, I obviously don’t want to suck at it...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我显然不想做得很烂……

lines.en: : That’s...kind of adorable.
lines.zh: : 那……有点可爱。

lines.en: : I know it is. I’m an adorable girl.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我是个可爱的女孩。

lines.en: : You should say that more.
lines.zh: : 你该多说说那句。

lines.en: : I will do my best to remember...
lines.zh: : 我会尽力记住的……

lines.en: scene black
Kirin and I part ways with an extremely brief goodbye.
lines.zh: Kirin 和我用一句极短的道别分开了。

lines.en: I watch her take her phone out of her pocket and start typing out a message or social media post the second we part ways.
lines.zh: 我看着她从口袋里掏出手机，我们一分道她就开始打字，像是在发短信或者发社交动态。

lines.en: I hope she isn’t writing anything about me.
lines.zh: 希望她不是在写关于我的什么。

lines.en: I feel like tonight’s conversation could have gone a little better...
lines.zh: 我觉得今晚的对话本可以再顺利一点……
